title: Generation of neurospheres from embryonic stem cells for investigating the temporal specification of neural stem/progenitor cells
protocol: Culture ES cells on gelatin-coated flasks with 20–30 ml of ES medium in a humidified tissue culture incubator.
Change the ES medium every day.
Passage ES cells when they cover 80% of the surface, usually 3 or 4 days after seeding.
Wash the cells twice with PBS quickly.
Cover the cells with a thin film of 1 ml trypsin-EDTA solution and incubate for 1 min in the incubator.
Resuspend the ES cells in 10 ml fresh ES medium by thoroughly pipetting them up and down to achieve single-cell culture or aggregates of 2–3 cells.
Passage 5% of the ES cell suspension for 3 days of culture or 2% for 4 days into fresh 20–30 ml of ES medium in a new gelatin-coated flask.
Trypsinize ES cells as described in Step 3.
Resuspend the ES cells in 10 ml fresh EB medium by thoroughly pipetting them up and down several times.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 170 g, resuspend them in 30 ml EB medium, and count the cells.
Plate the single-cell ES cell suspension in 50 ml fresh EB medium at a density of 10^5 cells/ml onto 15-cm bacterial dishes.
Culture 6 days without changing the medium.
Transfer the 6-day-cultured EBs into 50-ml conical tubes and allow them to settle for 10 min.
Carefully aspirate most of the supernatant, resuspend and collect the EBs together in 30 ml of PBS.
Allow the EBs to settle for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant, resuspend the EBs in 1.5 ml of trypsin-EDTA solution.
Incubate the EBs for 5 min at 37°C.
Quench the trypsinization by adding 3 ml FBS and thoroughly dissociate the EBs using a transfer pipette 30 times.
Transfer the suspension into a 15-ml conical tube and bring the volume up to 12 ml with MHM.
After 2 min, transfer the suspension except for 1 ml at the bottom of each tube into a new conical tube to remove undissociated cell clumps.
Repeat Step 15.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 170 g and resuspend the pellet in 10 ml MHM.
Repeat step 17.
Count the cells, prepare a single-cell suspension in 40 ml MHM with 1 ml FGF (1 μg/ml) at a density of 5 x 10^4 to 10^5 cells/ml, and plate the cells onto non-coated T75 cell culture flasks.
Culture for 6 days without changing the medium but add 1 ml FGF (1 μg/ml) at day 3.
Transfer 6-day-cultured neurospheres into 50-ml conical tubes and centrifuge for 5 min at 170 g.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant and add 1 ml of fresh MHM.
Dissociate the neurospheres mechanically by pipetting them with a P1000 Pipetman.
Add 20 ml of MHM and centrifuge for 5 min at 170 g.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the appropriate volume of MHM.
Plate 500 μl of the suspension onto fibronectin-coated coverslips.
Culture cells for 5 days without changing the medium.
Add 1 ml FGF (1 μg/ml) to the rest of the cell suspension.
Transfer the cell suspension into a new non-coated T75 cell culture flask.
Culture cells for 6 days without changing the medium.
